name: Button
purpose: Triggers an action in the current view (submit, save, open a modal). For navigation to another page or URL, use Link.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis. Use one primary per view.

props.name: size
props.description: Height 32/40/48px. Hit area is always ≥44px on touch.

props.name: children
props.description: Label text. Use a verb: 'Save score', not 'OK'.

props.name: iconStart
props.description: Icon before the label (or the only icon when iconOnly).

props.name: iconEnd
props.description: Icon after the label (e.g. chevron-down, arrow).

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Hide the label and show only iconStart. Requires aria-label (web) / accessibilityLabel (native).

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, sets aria-busy, ignores presses but stays focusable.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to container width (common on mobile forms).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button. Prefer explaining why an action is unavailable.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over: background shifts to intent.*.bgHover.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: 2px focus ring offset by 2px.

states.name: loading
states.description: Spinner replaces iconStart; aria-busy=true; presses ignored.

states.name: disabled
states.description: intent.disabled colors; not focusable; not-allowed cursor.

tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on touch devices.

keyboard.action: Move focus to / from the button.

screenReader: Icon-only buttons announce their aria-label; the icon itself is aria-hidden.
Loading announces the loadingLabel and aria-busy.
accessibility.focus: Visible 2px ring in color.focus.ring with 2px offset on :focus-visible only. Never remove it.
accessibility.touchTarget: ≥44×44px on coarse pointers via an invisible hit-area expansion; visual size unchanged.
notes: Do not use a <div> or <a> with onClick as a button.
If an icon-only button has a visible tooltip, the tooltip text must match the aria-label (2.5.3).

variants.name: primary
variants.useWhen: The single main action of a view: 'Create tournament', 'Checkout'.

variants.name: secondary
variants.useWhen: Alternative actions next to a primary: 'Cancel', 'Export'.

variants.name: tertiary
variants.useWhen: Low-emphasis actions in toolbars, cards, tables.

variants.name: danger
variants.useWhen: Destructive, irreversible actions: 'Delete team'. Usually confirm with a Modal.

do: Start labels with a verb and keep them short (1–3 words).
Use one primary button per view or section.
Place the primary action last (right) in button groups and modals.
Use loading for async actions instead of disabling.
dont: Don't use a Button to navigate to a URL — use Link.
Don't put more than one primary or danger button side by side.
Don't use icon-only buttons for uncommon actions; add a label.
Don't disable submit buttons to signal validation errors; show field errors instead.

related.name: Dropdown
related.reason: Group overflow actions behind a menu button.

example.web:
<Button variant="primary" iconStart="plus" onClick={createMatch}>New match</Button>
<Button variant="secondary" onClick={close}>Cancel</Button>
<Button iconOnly iconStart="trash" variant="tertiary" aria-label="Delete player" />
example.native:
<Button variant="primary" iconStart="plus" onPress={createMatch}>New match</Button>
<Button iconOnly iconStart="trash" variant="tertiary" accessibilityLabel="Delete player" onPress={remove} />
